:::{#exm-estimated-chance-agreement}
#### Estimated chance agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the [agreement table](#def-agreement-table) of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the [estimated chance agreement](#def-estimated-chance-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
\Est{p}_e
&= \frac{786 \times 700 + 9{,}214 \times 9{,}300}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(definition of } \Est{p}_e \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{550{,}200 + 85{,}690{,}200}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= \frac{86{,}240{,}400}{10{,}000^2}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&= \frac{86{,}240{,}400}{100{,}000{,}000}
&& \text{(square)} \\
&= 0.862404
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-estimated-chance-agreement}

This [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) equals the [chance agreement](#def-chance-agreement) $p_e = 0.862404$ of @exm-chance-agreement,
because the table's marginal [sample proportions](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-proportion) equal the marginal [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $\Prf{\posclass}$, $\Prf{D}$, $\Prf{\negclass}$, and $\Prf{\neg D}$.
:::
